tools.name: getInboxStatus
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether inbound email is ready or needs setup. Returns domains, routes, deployed Functions, and recent inbound activity. Changing that setup is done with the domain tools (listDomains, addDomain, verifyDomain), which are listed at the full endpoint, /mcp/full.

tools.description: Use this when the user has selected a specific inbound email and confirmed a reply. Sends real outbound email with threading handled server-side. When you expect an answer back, pass await_reply: true and it is returned in this same result.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "createEmailAddress" references sensitive artifacts (password, api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get this user's Primitive managed inbox domain, creating the account on first use: no signup form, no password, no email verification, no browser. CALL THIS FIR…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: getOutboundStatus, listEmails, searchEmails, getEmail, listSentEmails, getSentEmail, awaitReply, getConversation, getEmailAttachment, createEmailAddress · Private data: getEmail, getSentEmail, getEmailAttachment, createEmailAddress · Public sink: getAccount, getInboxStatus, getOutboundStatus, listEmails, searchEmails, getEmail, replyToEmail, sendEmail, listSentEmails, getSentEmail, awaitReply, getConversation, getEmailAttachment, createEmailAddress.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: getOutboundStatus, listEmails, searchEmails, getEmail, listSentEmails, getSentEmail, awaitReply, getConversation, getEmailAttachment, createEmailAddress · Private data: getEmail, getSentEmail, getEmailAttachment, createEmailAddress · Public sink: getAccount, getInboxStatus, getOutboundStatus, listEmails, searchEmails, getEmail, replyToEmail, sendEmail, listSentEmails, getSentEmail, awaitReply, getConversation, getEmailAttachment, createEmailAddress

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
